scope: Bounded independent scientific/lay review; saved artifacts only, no raw photometry/FITS headers, fits, candidate-sector access or canonical edits. Only this audit file was written.
version_note: Findings concern the original handoff; integrated_status records the parent changes visible at final read. Parent may subsequently tighten cited claim IDs or wording.
positive_findings: All numerical findings reproduce at the stated rounding.
The chosen one-sentence message matches03 exactly.
Nine to ten hours for HR858c is correct for independent PDCSAP timings; the additional SAP route can reach10.5h but need not be reported in this short brief.
Expected perturbation pattern is appropriately nonexclusive; it does not claim proof of a unique cause.
Shared-data and catalogue-wide failure-rate limitations are useful and remain.
The integrated scope/tuning/policy edits address the material simplification risks.
minor_optional_wording: Use the planet's atmosphere rather than its atmosphere to remove the star/planet pronoun ambiguity.
Timing ranges is more literal than whole forecasts for a central95% interval score.

findings.finding: Every rule first overstates pre-access fixing: DRC comparison, PIT asymmetry and allocation screen were post-review additions on inspected outputs.
proposed_wording: We fixed the main test first.
The 2022-edition comparison, early/late pattern and targeting screen were later descriptive checks of measurements already inspected.

findings.finding: Conditional accepted-injection calibration omits that the final rule was tuned on the same samples.
proposed_wording: Artificial transits in real data gave appropriately calibrated ranges for accepted timings, on the same development samples used to tune the rule.

findings.finding: Counts and benchmark replay concern accepted timings, not all attempts or measured/rejected timings.
proposed_wording: We provide a package that reproduces the saved scores for every accepted timing.
findings.integrated_status: Product and first sample statement now explicitly say accepted; remaining measured wording is interpreted within that defined sample.

findings.finding: The baseline coverage tests combined forecast-and-measurement uncertainty with reconstructed correlation; 91% is an equal-planet average, not issued-error-only or an event average.
proposed_wording: The combined prediction and measurement ranges were a little too narrow.
After the linked-uncertainty explanation: We had to estimate that missing link.
findings.integrated_status: Combined range and equal-planet conditions are resolved. Parent advised to disclose that the missing correlation link was estimated.

findings.finding: No rule beat even spending sounds broader than the six rankings and restricted allocation policy; outcomes were inspected DRC forecasts, not a fresh warning-rule trial.
proposed_wording: On inspected 2022-edition forecasts, none of the tested schemes beat both simple equal-budget alternatives.
findings.integrated_status: Resolved in the current draft, including both comparators and measured midpoints.

findings.finding: One catalogued planet means one listed in the tested edition, not physically single or absent from all catalogues. The exploratory extension combines long-period/multiplanet targets and yielded only five accepted planets; the recovery method is not validated for multiplanet systems.
proposed_wording: One planet listed in the tested edition.
The wider exploratory sample yielded accepted timings for only five planets; finding transits on multi-planet stars is not yet validated.

findings.finding: Direct claim links can be strengthened for primary offsets, all-model noncapture and pre-origin features. Slight is subjective and unnecessary.
proposed_wording: C046,C059 for gain/noncapture; C048,C050,C051 for HR858 offsets/checks; C048,C054 for prior features; C042,C045 for package and pre-access execution chronology.
findings.integrated_status: Slight removed. Parent advised on tighter claim-ID links.

conclusion: No numerical defect; material initial scope omissions now addressed, with small claim-link and missing-correlation disclosure recommendations sent to parent.
